name: Micro-Pattern Repetition
description: Detects anomalous cyclical phrasing, n-gram reuse, and structural loops characteristic of AI-generated text. Large Language Models, particularly when using specific decoding strategies like beam search without sufficient repetition penalties, often suffer from 'neural text degeneration'—a tendency to get stuck in localized, repetitive micro-patterns. Even when surface words change slightly, the underlying syntactic structures or specific n-grams are reused at a rate much higher than human writing.
algorithm: N-gram Autocorrelation and Neural Degeneration Profiling
mechanism: The system computes the frequency and distribution of specific word sequences (n-grams) and syntactic structures across the text. It applies an autocorrelation function to detect cyclical patterns (e.g., using a specific 3-gram every 50 words). AI models rely heavily on their immediate context window, leading them to constantly 'prime' themselves with their own recent outputs, causing them to predictably loop back to the same phrasing structures. The algorithm measures the entropy and coefficient of variation of these patterns, flagging texts where the structural repetition is statistically too perfect or too frequent.
useCase: Highly effective for auditing long-form conversational responses, creative writing generated by older or unoptimized models, and texts where AI was forced to generate beyond its contextual comfort zone.
strengths:
• Exceptional at detecting 'hallucinated padding' where the AI tries to maintain length by looping.
• Language-agnostic baseline; the mathematical fingerprint of neural repetition remains consistent across different languages.
limitations:
• Less effective against text generated with high 'temperature' settings or heavy repetition penalties, which explicitly force the model to break these loops.
• May flag highly structured human writing, such as technical manuals or poetry that intentionally uses refrain.
parameters:
Analysis: Adaptive Syntactic and N-gram Autocorrelation
Metric: Repetition Frequency Variance and Entropy
Output: 0-100 Neural Degeneration (Looping) Score
accuracy: Moderate to High — 74-84% accuracy. Acts as a core statistical pillar in detection pipelines when paired with Perplexity and Burstiness.

references.title: Holtzman, A. et al. (2020). The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration. ICLR.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.

source: Holtzman, A. et al. (2020). The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration. ICLR.; Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
